channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: Aston Villa wins 8th straight game with 2-1 victory over Basel in Europa League
item.description: Villa is tied with Lyon and Midtjylland atop the standings of the second-tier European competition on 15 points with five wins from six games.

item.title: Kamal Haasan celebrates '75 years of a remarkable life' as Rajinikanth turns a year older
item.description: Two of the most celebrated names in Indian cinema, Haasan and Rajinikanth, have collaborated on numerous projects in multiple languages, such as Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Hindi, over the years.

item.title: Japan issues tsunami advisory after 6.7 magnitude quake in country's northeast
item.description: The Pacific coast of Hokkaido, Aomori, Iwate and Miyagi prefectures could see a tsunami of up to 1 meter (3.2 feet), the agency added.

item.title: Drumstick and beetroot get cheaper while cauliflower get costlier at Chennai's Koyambedu market on Dec 12, 2025
item.description: Planning your grocery run? Check today’s vegetable prices in Chennai before you head out.

item.title: Act in 7 days to protect Sunil Gavaskar's personality rights, Delhi HC tells social media platforms
item.description: Justice Manmeet Pritam Singh Arora asked Gavaskar's counsel to first approach the social media intermediaries with his grievances.

item.title: WHO refutes US CDC's claims on vaccines and autism, reaffirms there is no link
item.description: The WHO conducted a new analysis after the CDC under President Donald Trump last month changed its long-held stance and claimed that the consensus that vaccines don’t cause autism is not “an evidence-based claim”.

item.title: Rajinikanth turns 75, Jackie Shroff says ‘happiness always’
item.description: Rajinikanth has a career spanning over five decades and has done 170 films in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Bangla, and Malayalam.

item.title: Don't want Gill to justify his place, want him to play like he does in IPL: ten Doeschate
item.description: Gill was brought back into the T20 setup with the Asia Cup in September after he led India to two famous Test wins in the drawn five-match series in England

item.title: Sentencing of Pakistan's former ISI chief 'just the begining': Report
item.description: A statement issued by the army on his sentencing focused on his conviction under military laws. However, it was the final paragraph that drew the most attention, according to a Dawn report.

item.title: CM Stalin greets Rajinikanth on his 75th birthday
item.description: Stalin praised his open-hearted speeches and said, from six to sixty, he has captivated people for half a century.
